title: [review] messaging.py:93: sent_messages returns direct r
description: Unlike inbox() at line 97 which returns `[dict(message) for message in self._inbox]` (shallow copies), sent_messages() returns `[self._sent[msg_id] for msg_id in self._sent_order]` (direct references). Callers can mutate internal state by modifying returned dicts. Same issue exists in sent_message() at line 101.
close_reason: Fixed: sent_messages() and sent_message() now return shallow copies (dict()) instead of direct references, consistent with inbox()
